We have applied templates in order: 20810 gave two products: product1 = "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and product2 = "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". The required order of templates: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied 20810, then 2895 on product1 gave nitro substituted version: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". Good.

Then 1914397 on that gave two fragments: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". So we have split into two molecules.

Next 1914398 applied to the second fragment gave "BrBr" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". So we have a bromine dimer side product and a core.

Now need to apply 1914399 to the core "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". We checked and it matches, but we haven't applied yet. Let's apply 1914399.
